component.name: Opentern
component.summary: Market charts, backtests and paper trading

description.p: This community package is independently maintained and repackages the official Linux release unmodified.
Opentern is a local-first market analysis terminal with charts, indicators, scripts, backtests, alerts and paper trading. It does not place real orders.

Market data needs network access. The sandbox does not provide access to Python interpreters or coding agents installed on the host; those integrations may not work. Background alerts that run after the app closes may also be unavailable.

In-app alerts work by default. Desktop notifications and alert sounds are optional. To let Opentern use the desktop notification service, run flatpak override --user --talk-name=org.freedesktop.Notifications io.github.ahaan_shah.Opentern and restart the app. In the alert editor, enable Notification for desktop notifications and enable Sound as well to hear the alert.
